_note: Draft English rendering of Saadia's JA Tafsir on Vayikra 25, generated by scripts/translate_tafsir_english.py against the JA (not the biblical Hebrew). Translation goal: reverse-translatability for the Tafsir reader — readers should be able to map English back to JA. Saadia-specific moves preserved per data-source/saadia-gloss-table.json; Blau's notes (data-source/blau-genesis-notes.json) consulted for Bereshit 1-12.

translations.1: Then God spoke to Moses, on Mount Sinai, a speaking.
translations.2: Command the sons of Israel and say to them: When you enter the land which I am giving you, then let the land desist — a desisting for God.
translations.3: That there be six years in which you sow your estate, and six years in which you tend your vineyard, and gather its yield.
translations.4: But in the seventh year there shall be a desisting for the land — it is a sabbath for God; do not sow your estate, and do not tend your vineyard.
translations.5: The aftergrowth of your harvest you shall not reap, and the single grapes of your vineyard you shall not pluck — for it is a year of desisting for the land.
translations.6: And let what grows from the desisted land be for you as food — for you, and for your male slave, and for your female slave, and for your hired worker, and for your guest, who dwell with you.
translations.7: And for your beasts, and for the wild creatures that are in your land, all its yield shall be for food.
translations.8: Then count seven years of desisting — and those seven years, seven times — so that the sum of that shall be forty-nine years.
translations.9: And sound a gathering horn on the tenth day of the seventh month — it is the Day of Atonement — sound it throughout all your lands.
translations.11: And among the conditions of this year of release, the year of fifty: you shall not sow in it, and you shall not reap its aftergrowth, and you shall not pluck its single grapes.
translations.12: For it is a year of release — it shall be holy for you; from the open country you shall eat its yield as that which is freely permitted.
translations.13: And in this year of release, every man shall return to his holding.
translations.14: And when you sell a sale to your fellow, or buy from him, let no one wrong his brother.
translations.15: By the count of years after the year of release you shall buy from your fellow, and by the count of years of its yield he shall sell to you.
translations.16: According to the abundance of the years, the price must be increased for him; and according to the fewness of them, it is permitted that it be decreased for him — for it is a counted number of yields that he is selling you.
translations.17: And let no one wrong his fellow; and fear your Lord — for I am God, your Lord, who punishes.
translations.18: And perform My statutes, and My ordinances — keep them and act by them; and dwell in the land, trusting in Me.
translations.19: The land shall bring forth its fruit for you, and you shall eat it with enjoyment, and you shall settle therein, trusting.
translations.20: And if you say: What shall we eat in the seventh year, since we do not sow, and do not gather our yield —
translations.21: I shall command My blessing upon you in the sixth year, and its yield shall suffice you for three years.
translations.22: And you shall sow in the eighth year, while you are eating from the old yield — until the ninth year, until the coming of its yield, you shall eat what is old.
translations.23: And the land shall not be sold outright — for it is Mine; you are but residents and guests with Me.
translations.24: And throughout all the land of your holding, grant dominion over the land.
translations.25: And if your brother becomes impoverished and sells something of his holding, then let his nearest guardian come and take charge of his brother's sale.
translations.26: And any man who has no guardian — if his hand reaches, and he finds the measure of his redemption —
translations.27: let him reckon the years of his sale, and return the surplus to the man to whom he sold it, and he shall return to his holding.
translations.28: And if his hand does not reach the measure of what he is to return to him, then his sale shall remain in the hand of its buyer until the year of release; and in that year it shall go out, and he shall return to his holding.
translations.29: And any man who sells a dwelling house in a town that has a wall — he shall have the option until the completion of a year from the day of his sale; his redemption shall be a full year.
translations.30: And if he does not redeem it by the time a full year is completed for him, then the house in the town that has a wall is confirmed outright for the buyer and his generations — it shall not go out in the year of release.
translations.31: But houses of the outlying settlements that have no wall surrounding them shall be reckoned like the estates of the open country — dominion shall apply to them, and they shall go out in the year of release.
translations.32: But as for the towns of the Levites, and the houses of their towns which are their holding — they have the right to redeem them forever.
translations.33: And whoever buys from them — every sold house and the towns of the holding of whichever Levite it may be shall go out in the year of release — for their houses and their towns are their holding among the sons of Israel.
translations.34: But the estates of the open ground around their towns shall not be sold at all — for it is their holding forever.
translations.35: And if your brother becomes impoverished and his hand falters with you, then strengthen him — that he be as a resident and a guest with you — and let him live with you.
translations.36: Do not take from him a sample-interest nor usury; and fear your Lord, so that your brother may live with you.
translations.37: And do not advance to him your money or your food at sample-interest, nor at usury.
translations.38: I am God, your Lord, who brought you out from the land of Egypt, to give you the land of Canaan, that I may be your God.
translations.39: And if your brother becomes impoverished with you and sells himself to you, do not press him into the service of slaves.
translations.40: Rather, as a hired worker or a guest he shall be with you; until the year of release he shall serve you.
translations.41: Then he shall go out from your presence — he and his sons with him — and return to his clan and to the holding of his father.
translations.42: For they are My servants whom I brought out from the land of Egypt — they shall not be sold in the manner of the sale of slaves.
translations.43: And do not hold dominion over him with cruelty; and fear your Lord.
translations.44: And your male slave and your female slave who shall be yours — from the nations that are around you, from them you may acquire slaves and maidservants.
translations.45: Also from the children of the residents who dwell with you, you may buy from them; and from their clans born in your land — and they shall be a holding for you.
translations.46: You shall bequeath them to your sons after you as an inheritance, and you may press them into service forever; but as for your brothers the sons of Israel, no one shall hold dominion over his brother with cruelty.
translations.47: And if the hand of a stranger or a resident with you reaches, and your brother becomes impoverished with him, and sells himself to a stranger or a resident with you, or to the root of the stranger's clan —
translations.48: after he has been sold there shall be a redemption for him; one of his brothers shall redeem him.
translations.49: Or his uncle or his uncle's son shall redeem him, or one of the near kinsmen of his own person from his clan shall redeem him; or if his hand reaches, he shall redeem himself.
translations.50: And he shall reckon with his buyer how many years he was sold to him until the year of release; and the price of his sale shall be apportioned according to the count of the years, and he shall be with him in those years as the days of a hired worker.
translations.51: If many years remain, according to their measure he shall return his redemption, proportioned from the price of his purchase.
translations.52: And if few years remain until the year of release, he shall reckon with him — according to their measure he shall return his redemption.
translations.53: In sum, as a hired worker year by year he shall be with him; he shall not hold dominion over him with cruelty in your presence.
translations.54: And if he is not redeemed by these means, then he shall go out in the year of release — he and his sons with him.
translations.55: For the sons of Israel are servants to Me — since they are My servants, whom I brought out from the land of Egypt: I am God, your Lord; serve Me.
